# KD

> KD is a symbolic-regression platform for equation discovery from field observations and tabular data.

The linked documentation describes installation, data loading, algorithm configuration and results. Algorithm pages combine shared method descriptions with generated parameter tables and worked examples.

The PyPI distribution is `sail-kd`; Python code imports `kd`. After installation, `kd.instrument_schemas()` describes the algorithms and parameters available in that environment. Read the installation and data guides before running an example on a user's file.

## Entry points

- [Installation](https://scientific-artificial-intelligence-lab.github.io/kd/start/installation/): Python requirements, uv and pip commands, environment activation and optional components.
- [Getting started](https://scientific-artificial-intelligence-lab.github.io/kd/start/): Installation, a first fit and your own data.
- [User guide](https://scientific-artificial-intelligence-lab.github.io/kd/guide/): Data, algorithms, scores, visualization, checkpoints and batch runs.
- [Experimental controller](https://scientific-artificial-intelligence-lab.github.io/kd/guide/controller/): Endpoint setup, data files, interactive searches and reports.
- [Agent search example](https://scientific-artificial-intelligence-lab.github.io/kd/guide/agent-example/): A checkpoint/resume demonstration, results from both search segments and interactive requests.
- [Architecture](https://scientific-artificial-intelligence-lab.github.io/kd/design/architecture/): The complete component diagram, package layers and execution order.
- [Data loading](https://scientific-artificial-intelligence-lab.github.io/kd/data/shape/): Array construction, kd.load, kd.inspect_file, mappings, axes and left-hand sides.
- [Algorithm overview](https://scientific-artificial-intelligence-lab.github.io/kd/algorithms/): Algorithm capabilities and links to their reference pages.
- [API reference](https://scientific-artificial-intelligence-lab.github.io/kd/api/): Import locations, signatures and parameters.

## Algorithms

- [SGA-PDE](https://scientific-artificial-intelligence-lab.github.io/kd/algorithms/sga/)
- [DLGA-PDE](https://scientific-artificial-intelligence-lab.github.io/kd/algorithms/dlga/)
- [DISCOVER](https://scientific-artificial-intelligence-lab.github.io/kd/algorithms/discover/)
- [EqGPT](https://scientific-artificial-intelligence-lab.github.io/kd/algorithms/eqgpt/)
- [LLM4ED](https://scientific-artificial-intelligence-lab.github.io/kd/algorithms/llm4ed/)
- [PySR](https://scientific-artificial-intelligence-lab.github.io/kd/algorithms/pysr/)
- [PySINDy](https://scientific-artificial-intelligence-lab.github.io/kd/algorithms/pysindy/)
